login.panelText: Events, approvals, pages and settings for eestec.mk. For the board and organizing teams only.
login.signInText: Use your admin e-mail. Members sign in on the main site.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device for 14 days
login.forgotText: Enter your admin e-mail and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
login.noAccess: No access to this e-mail any more? Ask a super admin to update your account.
login.sentText: If {email} has an admin account, a reset link is on its way. The link works for 30 minutes.
login.sentHelp: Not there? Check spam, or ask a super admin.
login.twoFactorText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.backupText: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up 2-step login.
login.unavailableText: The admin panel opens once eestec.mk is connected to its database. Until then nobody can sign in here.

errors.codeWrong: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the newest one.
errors.backupWrong: That backup code didn't work. Each code works once.
errors.wrongText: {count, plural, =0 {Sign-in now pauses for 15 minutes.} one {1 more try, then sign-in pauses for 15 minutes.} other {# more tries, then sign-in pauses for 15 minutes.}}
errors.lockedText: Too many wrong tries. You can try again after {time}, or reset your password.
errors.notStaffTitle: This account has no admin access
errors.notStaffText: Members sign in on the main site. Ask a super admin if you should have access.

dashboard.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to that page
dashboard.forbiddenText: Ask a super admin if you need it.
